source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Hershey-Chase experiment (PDF 121-122).

blocks.text: 1952 mein do American biologists, Alfred Hershey aur Martha Chase, ne yeh pakka karne ke liye tajarbe kiye ke DNA hi genetic material hai. Un ka asal tajarba bacteriophages (bacteria par hamla karne wale viruses) ke saath tha.

Pas-e-manzar (background information): bacteriophage ka andar ka hissa (core) DNA ya RNA ka hota hai aur bahar protein ka coat. Jab lytic bacteriophage kisi bacterium ko infect karta hai to us ki satah se chipak kar kuch material cell ke andar inject karta hai. Yeh material hereditary (moroosi) hai, kyun ke yahi bacterium ke andar naye bacteriophages banwata hai. Aakhir mein bacterial cell phat jata hai (lyse hota hai) aur naye bacteriophages bahar aa jate hain.
Sawal: bacteriophages bacterial cell mein kaun sa material (DNA/RNA, protein ya dono) inject karte hain jo naye bacteriophages banwata hai?

Tajarba: Hershey aur Chase ne aisa bacteriophage liya jis mein RNA nahin balke DNA tha. Unhon ne bacteriophage ke DNA aur protein par alag alag radioactive isotopes ka nishan (label) lagaya; yeh isotopes tracers (peecha karne wale nishan) ka kaam karte. Is ke liye:

items: Kuch bacteriophages aise medium par ugaye gaye jis mein sulphur ka isotope (³⁵S) tha. Yeh isotope naye bacteriophages ke protein coat ke amino acids mein shamil ho gaya.
Kuch bacteriophages aise medium par ugaye gaye jis mein phosphorus ka isotope (³²P) tha. Yeh isotope naye viruses ke DNA ke phosphate groups mein shamil ho gaya.
Setup 1 mein ³⁵S label wale protein ke bacteriophages ne bacteria ko infect kiya.
Setup 2 mein ³²P label wale DNA ke bacteriophages ne bacteria ko infect kiya.

blocks.text: Kuch der baad dono setups mein infected bacterial cells aur medium ko centrifugation (tezi se ghuma kar alag karne) se alag kiya gaya, aur phir cells aur medium mein radioactivity check ki gayi.

items: Setup 1 (³⁵S label wala protein): radioactivity medium mein mili, bacterial cells mein nahin.
Setup 2 (³²P label wala DNA): radioactivity bacterial cells mein mili, medium mein nahin.

blocks.text: In mushahidaat (observations) se pata chala ke infection ke dauran bacteriophage ka ³²P label wala DNA bacterial cells ke andar gaya aur naye bacteriophages banwaye, jab ke ³⁵S label wala protein coat bahar hi raha.
Isi bunyad par Hershey aur Chase ne kaha ke naye bacteriophages banwane ka zimmedar bacteriophage ka DNA hai, protein nahin.

blocks.alt: Do setups. Setup 1, radioactive sulphur (35S): radioactive protein ghilaf aur normal DNA wale phages bacteria par hamla karte hain; blender aur centrifugation ke baad radioactivity medium mein virus proteins mein hai aur bacterial cells mein koi radioactivity nahi. Setup 2, radioactive phosphorus (32P): radioactive DNA wale phages; blender aur centrifugation ke baad radioactivity bacterial cells ke andar virus DNA mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Do labels ke liye sulphur aur phosphorus hi kyun chune gaye?
blocks.explanation: Proteins mein sulphur hota hai (kuch amino acids mein) magar DNA mein nahin; DNA mein phosphorus hota hai (phosphate groups mein) magar protein mein taqreeban nahin. Is liye har isotope sirf aik cheez ko label karta hai.

items: ³⁵S ne bacteriophage ke protein ko label kiya, ³²P ne DNA ko.
³²P bacteria ke andar gaya; ³⁵S medium mein raha.
Naye bacteriophages DNA banwata hai, protein nahin.
